description: Create packages/ui-tokens with unified CSS custom properties (design tokens) and integrate into all three apps
steps: Create `packages/ui-tokens/` directory with package.json (name: @agent-army/ui-tokens, private: true)

Create `packages/ui-tokens/tokens.css` with unified CSS custom properties that are a superset of the three apps' existing tokens. Map them as follows: keep ajun-runtime's mint palette as the primary accent; normalize naming (--color-canvas, --color-surface, --color-ink, --color-muted, --color-line, --color-accent, --color-accent-soft, --color-danger, --color-danger-soft, --color-warning, --color-warning-soft, --color-info, --color-info-soft, --radius-sm, --radius, --radius-lg, --font-sans, --font-mono, --shadow-sm, --shadow-md). Include the app-specific aliases too (e.g. --mint maps to --color-accent for ajun).
Add `@import` or `<link>` to shared tokens in each app's HTML: apps/ajun-runtime/public/index.html, apps/project-progress-board/public/index.html, apps/xiaod-media-transcriber/public/index.html

Each app's styles.css :root block should reference the shared tokens where variable names overlap, but do NOT rewrite existing variable usage throughout all files - just add the import and map new token names to old. The apps continue working with their existing variable names.
Add ui-tokens to root package.json workspaces array: 'packages/*' already covers it
Verify with npm run check that nothing breaks
acceptance_criteria: packages/ui-tokens/tokens.css exists with unified design tokens
All three app index.html files link to or import the shared tokens CSS
Existing app styles still work (no visual regressions from variable rename)
verification: Confirm tokens.css has comprehensive variable definitions
findings: Architecture check (npm run check) exits 1 due to pre-existing repository-catalog.json area issue (area 'work' does not exist). This was already failing before the feature. All TypeScript compilation, frontend builds, and workspace checks pass. The runtime-http-handler.ts was at 748 lines (limit 750), so tokens.css route was combined with styles.css route to avoid exceeding the limit. The distribute:tokens script was added to the check pipeline to automatically copy tokens.css to each app's public/ before builds.
